words.enDefinition: an event in spring with stalls, games, or items for sale

examples.en: I bought a plant at the spring fair after my last lecture on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五最后一节课结束后，我在「春季市集」买了一株植物。

examples.en: The residence hall ran a stall at the spring fair to raise money locally.
examples.zh: 宿舍楼在「春季市集」摆摊，为本地项目筹款。

words.enDefinition: the time in spring when day and night are nearly equal in length

examples.en: The student society planned a talk about the spring equinox and seasonal traditions.
examples.zh: 学生社团安排了一场关于「春分」和时令习俗的讲座。

examples.en: We met near the garden around the spring equinox, when it stayed light later.
examples.zh: 「春分」前后，我们在花园附近见面，那时天黑得晚一些了。

words.enDefinition: the time of year with the longest period of daylight in one hemisphere

examples.en: Some students watched the sunset together on the summer solstice by the river.
examples.zh: 一些学生在「夏至」那天一起到河边看日落。

examples.en: A museum guide explained why the summer solstice mattered to some farming communities.
examples.zh: 博物馆的讲解员解释了为什么一些农业社区重视「夏至」。

collocations: the day of the summer solstice

words.enDefinition: the period around the middle of summer, often near the summer solstice

examples.en: The village held an outdoor concert at midsummer in the park near campus.
examples.zh: 「仲夏时节」，村里在校园附近的公园办了场露天音乐会。

examples.en: We visited friends at midsummer, when their evenings seemed to go on for hours.
examples.zh: 我们在「仲夏时节」拜访朋友，那时当地的傍晚感觉能持续好几个小时。

words.enDefinition: a weekend extended by one or more days off

examples.en: We spent the long weekend visiting a friend who had moved farther north.
examples.zh: 「连休小长假」期间，我们去看了一位搬到更北边的朋友。

examples.en: The buses will run less often during the long weekend near the end of May.
examples.zh: 五月底的「连休小长假」期间，公交车班次会少一些。

words.enDefinition: an officially recognized day on which many people get time off

examples.en: The campus library changed its opening hours because Monday was a public holiday.
examples.zh: 周一是「公众假日」，校园图书馆调整了开放时间。

examples.en: My flatmate checked which shops would open on the public holiday in June.
examples.zh: 室友查了六月的「公众假日」有哪些商店会开门。

words.enDefinition: a holiday formally established by law in a particular jurisdiction

examples.en: The Canadian campus calendar showed which Monday was a statutory holiday in our province.
examples.zh: 加拿大这所学校的校历标出了我们省哪一个周一是「法定假日」。

examples.en: My employer sent a reminder about opening hours on the next statutory holiday.
examples.zh: 雇主发了提醒，告知下一个「法定假日」的营业时间。

words.enDefinition: a holiday recognized by the US federal government

examples.en: The student handbook listed the federal holiday alongside the campus's own scheduled break.
examples.zh: 学生手册把「美国联邦假日」与学校自己安排的假期都列了出来。

examples.en: We checked whether the local office would open on the federal holiday next week.
examples.zh: 我们查了当地办事处下周「美国联邦假日」那天会不会开门。

words.enDefinition: wording saying that the holiday is officially observed on Monday

examples.en: The calendar said the holiday was observed on Monday because it fell on Sunday.
examples.zh: 节日本身在周日，日历标明「节日改在周一举行」。

examples.en: I checked which buses ran after seeing “Observed on Monday” on the notice.
examples.zh: 看到告示写着「节日改在周一举行」后，我查了哪些公交车有班次。

collocations: the date is observed on Monday
closed for the holiday observed on Monday

words.enDefinition: a weekday designated as a holiday in place of the usual date, especially in the UK

examples.en: The UK campus calendar said Monday was a substitute day for the bank holiday.
examples.zh: 英国这所大学的校历写着，周一是这次公众假日的「补假日」。

examples.en: The receptionist said the office would reopen on Tuesday after the substitute day.
examples.zh: 前台工作人员说，办事处过完「补假日」会在周二重新开放。

words.enDefinition: the times or places where services will close because of a holiday

examples.en: The residence app listed holiday closures for the library and sports centre that weekend.
examples.zh: 宿舍应用列出了那个周末图书馆和体育中心的「假日停业安排」。

examples.en: I checked the holiday closures before planning to study on campus with my classmates.
examples.zh: 安排和同学在校园学习前，我查了「假日停业安排」。

words.enDefinition: a public transport schedule used for a holiday instead of the usual weekday schedule

examples.en: The station used its holiday timetable on Monday, so we left home earlier.
examples.zh: 车站周一用的是「假日班次时刻表」，所以我们早一点出了门。

examples.en: Our last bus was at nine on the holiday timetable printed near the door.
examples.zh: 门边贴的「假日班次时刻表」显示，我们的末班车是九点。

words.enDefinition: road traffic affected or increased by travel for a holiday

examples.en: We left after lunch to avoid the worst holiday traffic near the city centre.
examples.zh: 我们午饭后出发，避开市中心附近最拥堵的「节假日车流」。

examples.en: The coach driver warned that holiday traffic could slow us down near the coast.
examples.zh: 大巴司机提醒，沿海一带的「节假日车流」可能会让我们开得慢一些。

words.enDefinition: a UK weekend extended by a nearby bank holiday

examples.en: We took the train to visit my sister over the bank holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 「公众假日连休周末」期间，我们坐火车去看了姐姐。

examples.en: The university kept its park open throughout the bank holiday weekend for local families.
examples.zh: 「公众假日连休周末」期间，学校的公园一直向当地家庭开放。

words.enDefinition: a Christian holiday celebrating the resurrection of Jesus, also marked by seasonal customs

examples.en: My aunt invited us to stay with her over Easter near the coast.
examples.zh: 姨妈邀请我们在「复活节」期间到她沿海的住处留宿。

examples.en: I asked my flatmate how her family usually spent Easter when she was young.
examples.zh: 我问室友小时候家里通常怎么过「复活节」。

words.enDefinition: the Sunday on which Easter is celebrated in a Christian calendar

examples.en: We met for lunch on Easter Sunday at my friend's house outside the city.
examples.zh: 「复活节星期日」那天，我们在朋友城外的家里一起吃午饭。

examples.en: The church displayed the times of its services for Easter Sunday on the noticeboard.
examples.zh: 教堂在公告栏上贴出了「复活节星期日」的礼拜时间。

words.enDefinition: the Friday before Easter Sunday, observed by Christians in memory of Jesus's death

examples.en: My friend checked the train schedule for Good Friday before booking her ticket home.
examples.zh: 朋友订回家车票前，查了「耶稣受难日」当天的火车时刻表。

examples.en: The church notice listed a service on Good Friday in the early evening.
examples.zh: 教堂的告示写着，「耶稣受难日」当天傍晚有场礼拜。

words.enDefinition: the week immediately before Easter in many Christian traditions

examples.en: One of the students gave a short talk on traditions during Holy Week in Spain.
examples.zh: 一名学生做了个简短介绍，讲西班牙「圣周」期间的传统。

examples.en: The small church published a separate calendar for Holy Week beside its usual schedule.
examples.zh: 小教堂在常规安排旁，另贴了一份「圣周」日程。

words.enDefinition: the Sunday before Easter, observed in memory of Jesus entering Jerusalem

examples.en: My neighbour invited me to a choir performance on Palm Sunday at her church.
examples.zh: 邻居邀请我去她的教堂看「棕枝主日」的合唱表演。

examples.en: The programme explained why palm branches appear in some Palm Sunday services each year.
examples.zh: 节目单解释了为什么有些「棕枝主日」礼拜每年会用到棕枝。

words.enDefinition: the Monday immediately after Easter Sunday

examples.en: The library will open later on Easter Monday because the staff timetable is different.
examples.zh: 由于值班安排不同，图书馆在「复活节星期一」会晚些开门。

examples.en: We came back to campus on Easter Monday after spending the weekend with friends.
examples.zh: 周末和朋友待在一起后，我们在「复活节星期一」回了学校。

words.enDefinition: a decorated egg or egg-shaped sweet associated with the Easter holiday

examples.en: My nephew left an Easter egg on the table for me when I visited.
examples.zh: 我去做客时，外甥在桌上给我留了一个「复活节彩蛋」。

examples.en: The children each painted an Easter egg before the picnic began in the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里的野餐开始前，孩子们各涂了一个「复活节彩蛋」。

words.enDefinition: an activity where people look for hidden eggs or egg-shaped sweets

examples.en: Our neighbours invited us to their Easter egg hunt in the small park.
examples.zh: 邻居邀请我们参加在小公园举办的「复活节寻蛋活动」。

examples.en: The Easter egg hunt ended when the last child found a chocolate egg under a bench.
examples.zh: 最后一个孩子在长椅下找到一枚巧克力蛋后，「复活节寻蛋活动」结束了。

words.enDefinition: an Easter activity in which people roll eggs along the ground

examples.en: The museum held an Easter egg roll on the lawn for visiting families.
examples.zh: 博物馆在草坪上为到访家庭举办了「复活节滚彩蛋活动」。

examples.en: I volunteered at the Easter egg roll and helped put signs on the path.
examples.zh: 我去「复活节滚彩蛋活动」做志愿者，帮忙在小路上放指示牌。

words.enDefinition: a basket filled with eggs, sweets, or other items for Easter

examples.en: My younger cousin carried an Easter basket while looking for eggs in the garden.
examples.zh: 年纪较小的表亲提着「复活节礼篮」在花园里找彩蛋。

examples.en: We filled the Easter basket with small chocolates from the shop near the station.
examples.zh: 我们用车站附近商店的小块巧克力装满了「复活节礼篮」。

words.enDefinition: an imaginary rabbit said to bring Easter eggs or gifts to children

examples.en: The library invited someone dressed as the Easter Bunny to its afternoon story session.
examples.zh: 图书馆请了一位扮成「复活节兔子」的人参加下午的故事会。

examples.en: My niece drew the Easter Bunny beside a basket on the card she made.
examples.zh: 外甥女在自己做的卡片上画了一只「复活节兔子」，旁边还有个篮子。

collocations: a picture of the Easter Bunny

words.enDefinition: the activity of painting or otherwise decorating eggs, often for Easter

examples.en: The residence office set out brushes for egg decorating in the common room.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室在公共休息室摆出了「彩蛋装饰活动」用的画笔。

examples.en: I tried egg decorating with my friends after our last class before the holiday.
examples.zh: 放假前最后一节课结束后，我和朋友一起做了「彩蛋装饰活动」。

words.enDefinition: a lightly spiced sweet bun marked with a cross, traditionally associated with Easter

examples.en: My flatmate brought me a hot cross bun from the bakery before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，室友从面包店给我带了一个「十字面包」。

examples.en: I bought a hot cross bun to try after seeing them in several Easter displays.
examples.zh: 我在几个复活节展台见过，就买了一个「十字面包」尝尝。

words.enDefinition: a decorated hat traditionally worn for some Easter events

examples.en: My neighbour was making an Easter bonnet for her daughter's school parade that weekend.
examples.zh: 邻居正在给女儿做一顶「复活节装饰帽」，准备周末学校游行戴。

examples.en: She pinned a paper flower to the Easter bonnet just before leaving home.
examples.zh: 临出门时，她在「复活节装饰帽」上别了一朵纸花。

words.enDefinition: a Christian worship gathering held for Easter

examples.en: A friend asked whether I wanted to attend an Easter service at her church.
examples.zh: 朋友问我要不要去她的教堂参加「复活节礼拜」。

examples.en: The choir practised a new song for the Easter service on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 合唱团为周日早上的「复活节礼拜」排练了一首新歌。

words.enDefinition: a meal between breakfast and lunch held to mark Easter

examples.en: We brought fruit to Easter brunch at my flatmate's aunt's house that Sunday.
examples.zh: 那天周日，我们带着水果去室友姨妈家吃「复活节早午餐」。

examples.en: The student café advertised Easter brunch for people staying near campus over the weekend.
examples.zh: 学生咖啡馆为周末留在校园附近的人宣传「复活节早午餐」。

words.enDefinition: a greeting wishing someone well during the Easter holiday

examples.en: My neighbour said “Happy Easter” as we walked past her garden on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日我们经过邻居的花园，她说：“「复活节快乐」。”

examples.en: I wrote “Happy Easter” on the card for my friend's family that weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我在给朋友家人的卡片上写了“「复活节快乐」”。

words.enDefinition: a Jewish spring holiday commemorating the biblical Exodus from Egypt

examples.en: The campus dining hall posted information for students observing Passover that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，学校食堂为过「犹太逾越节」的学生张贴了相关信息。

examples.en: I asked my friend what she usually did with her family during Passover.
examples.zh: 我问朋友，她家过「犹太逾越节」时通常会做些什么。

words.enDefinition: a ritual meal at Passover involving readings, foods, and the story of the Exodus

examples.en: My classmate invited me to a Passover seder at his family's home that evening.
examples.zh: 同学邀请我那晚去他家参加「逾越节家宴仪式」。

examples.en: The campus group explained what visitors could expect at its Passover seder on Friday.
examples.zh: 校园小组向来访者介绍了周五的「逾越节家宴仪式」会有哪些环节。

words.enDefinition: a plate holding symbolic foods used during a Passover seder

examples.en: The museum displayed an old seder plate beside photos from several different families.
examples.zh: 博物馆在几个家庭的照片旁展示了一个旧的「逾越节仪式餐盘」。

examples.en: My friend's grandmother explained one of the foods on the seder plate before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前，朋友的奶奶介绍了「逾越节仪式餐盘」上其中一种食物。

words.enDefinition: flat bread without leaven, eaten during Passover in Jewish tradition

examples.en: The shop put boxes of matzah on a separate shelf before Passover began.
examples.zh: 逾越节开始前，商店把一盒盒「逾越节无酵饼」放在单独的货架上。

examples.en: I tried matzah for the first time at my friend's family dinner that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，我在朋友的家宴上第一次尝了「逾越节无酵饼」。

words.enDefinition: a Jewish text read during the seder that recounts the Exodus

examples.en: We passed copies of the Haggadah around the table before the meal started.
examples.zh: 开饭前，我们把几本「逾越节仪式手册」在桌上传了一圈。

examples.en: The library exhibition showed an illustrated Haggadah next to a handwritten family note.
examples.zh: 图书馆的展览在一张家庭手写留言旁展示了一册插图版「逾越节仪式手册」。

words.enDefinition: a greeting wishing someone well during the Jewish holiday of Passover

examples.en: I wrote “Happy Passover” to my friend before she went home on the train.
examples.zh: 朋友坐火车回家前，我给她写了句“「逾越节快乐」”。

examples.en: The student society wished members “Happy Passover” in its message announcing the shared dinner.
examples.zh: 学生社团在公布聚餐的消息里祝成员“「逾越节快乐」”。

words.enDefinition: an Irish holiday honouring Saint Patrick and widely celebrated as an occasion for Irish culture

examples.en: The campus society held an Irish music session for St Patrick's Day after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，校园社团为「圣帕特里克节」办了一场爱尔兰音乐活动。

examples.en: We watched the St Patrick's Day parade with friends from our exchange programme downtown.
examples.zh: 我们和交换项目的朋友一起在市中心看了「圣帕特里克节」游行。

words.enDefinition: to dress in green, a common custom at some Saint Patrick's Day events

examples.en: My flatmate said she planned to wear green at the Irish society's evening concert.
examples.zh: 室友说，她打算「穿绿色衣服」去爱尔兰社团的晚间音乐会。

examples.en: Some people decided to wear green to the parade even though it was cold.
examples.zh: 虽然天气冷，还是有些人决定「穿绿色衣服」去看游行。

collocations: wear green on St Patrick's Day

words.enDefinition: ancestry or cultural traditions passed on from Ireland or Irish communities

examples.en: The library put together a display about Irish heritage in our town that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，图书馆做了一个介绍当地「爱尔兰文化传承」的展览。

examples.en: My classmate gave a short talk about her family's Irish heritage before the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会前，同学简短介绍了她家的「爱尔兰文化传承」。

words.enDefinition: dance forms from Irish tradition, including both solo and group styles

examples.en: The festival programme listed Irish dancing on the outdoor stage just after lunch.
examples.zh: 节庆节目单写着，午饭过后露天舞台会表演「爱尔兰舞」。

examples.en: My cousin took classes in Irish dancing and performed at the community centre.
examples.zh: 表亲上过「爱尔兰舞」课，还在社区中心表演过。

words.enDefinition: a three-leaved plant used as a symbol of Ireland

examples.en: The student drew a shamrock in the corner of the poster for the parade.
examples.zh: 那名学生在游行海报的角落画了一个「爱尔兰三叶草」。

examples.en: A small shamrock was printed on the card my Irish classmate gave me.
examples.zh: 我的爱尔兰同学送我的卡片上印了一个小小的「爱尔兰三叶草」。

words.enDefinition: an uncommon clover with four leaflets, widely regarded as a sign of good luck

examples.en: My classmate found a four-leaf clover beside the path on our walk to campus.
examples.zh: 我们走去学校时，同学在路边发现了一株「四叶草」。

examples.en: She pressed the four-leaf clover inside a notebook to keep it from getting crushed.
examples.zh: 她把「四叶草」夹在笔记本里，免得弄坏。

words.enDefinition: a saint regarded as a special protector of a place or group

examples.en: The museum display explained why Saint Patrick is considered Ireland's patron saint today.
examples.zh: 博物馆的展览解释了为什么圣帕特里克今天被视为爱尔兰的「守护圣人」。

examples.en: Our guide pointed out a picture of the city's patron saint near the entrance.
examples.zh: 导游指出入口附近一张描绘这座城市「守护圣人」的画。

collocations: feast day of a patron saint

words.enDefinition: the planned path that a parade follows through an area

examples.en: I checked the parade route before choosing a place to meet my classmate.
examples.zh: 我先查了「游行路线」，再选地方和同学碰头。

examples.en: The map showed the parade route ending outside the main community centre that afternoon.
examples.zh: 地图显示，当天下午的「游行路线」终点在主要的社区中心外。

words.enDefinition: a public procession through streets organized to celebrate or mark an event

examples.en: The street parade passed our bus stop just as we arrived for the festival.
examples.zh: 我们刚到庆典会场，「街头游行」就经过了公交站。

examples.en: My friend brought a camera to the street parade because her sister was taking part.
examples.zh: 朋友的姐姐要参加「街头游行」，于是朋友带上了相机。

collocations: take part in a street parade

words.enDefinition: a designated public space for watching part of an event

examples.en: Staff directed families to the viewing area beside the main path through the park.
examples.zh: 工作人员把家庭观众引到公园主路旁的「观看区」。

examples.en: We reached the viewing area early enough to find seats together near the front.
examples.zh: 我们很早就到了「观看区」，在前面找到了挨在一起的座位。

words.enDefinition: to stand in rows along the sides of streets, often to watch an event

examples.en: People began to line the streets as soon as the parade music started.
examples.zh: 游行音乐一响起，人们就开始「沿街排开围观」。

examples.en: We watched families line the streets around the square before the festival procession.
examples.zh: 庆典队伍经过前，我们看见许多家庭在广场周围「沿街排开围观」。

collocations: line the streets for a parade

words.enDefinition: in its spring festival sense, a celebration on May first with local seasonal customs

examples.en: We watched maypole dancing at a May Day celebration in a village near campus.
examples.zh: 我们在校园附近一个村庄的「五月节」庆典上看到了彩带柱舞。

examples.en: I learned about May Day traditions during a weekend visit to my friend's village.
examples.zh: 周末去朋友的村子做客时，我了解了「五月节」的习俗。

words.enDefinition: a tall pole often decorated with ribbons for some European spring celebrations

examples.en: The village had a maypole decorated with ribbons in the centre of the green.
examples.zh: 村里的公共草坪中央立着一根扎满彩带的「五月节彩带柱」。

examples.en: The museum guide showed us an old photograph of the maypole beside the school.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解员给我们看了一张学校旁「五月节彩带柱」的老照片。

words.enDefinition: traditional dancing around a pole, often with ribbons attached to it

examples.en: The children practised maypole dancing on the grass before their families arrived that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午家人到来前，孩子们在草地上练习「绕五月节彩带柱跳舞」。

examples.en: I watched maypole dancing for the first time at a fair near the university.
examples.zh: 我在大学附近的市集上第一次看见有人「绕五月节彩带柱跳舞」。

words.enDefinition: a traditional English folk dance often performed in groups at local events

examples.en: The Morris dancing group performed in front of the library during the spring fair.
examples.zh: 春季市集期间，「英格兰莫里斯舞」团队在图书馆前表演。

examples.en: Our guide mentioned Morris dancing when we asked about events on the village green.
examples.zh: 我们问村里的公共草坪上有什么活动时，导游提到了「英格兰莫里斯舞」。

words.enDefinition: a grassy public space in a village, often used for gathering

examples.en: The summer fair occupied the village green across the road from the post office.
examples.zh: 夏季市集在邮局对面的「村庄公共草坪」上举行。

examples.en: We sat on the village green with some classmates after the local concert.
examples.zh: 当地音乐会结束后，我们和几个同学坐在「村庄公共草坪」上。

words.enDefinition: a village event with stalls, games, and entertainment, especially in Britain

examples.en: My neighbour baked cakes for the village fête that raised money for the hall.
examples.zh: 邻居给为村礼堂筹款的「乡村游园会」烤了蛋糕。

examples.en: I took the bus to the village fête with a friend from my course.
examples.zh: 我和同一门课的朋友一起坐公交去「乡村游园会」。

words.enDefinition: a UK bank holiday usually observed near the end of May

examples.en: The office moved our meeting because it would close for the spring bank holiday.
examples.zh: 办公室因「英国春季公众假日」要关闭，于是把我们的会议改期了。

examples.en: We booked the coast trip for the spring bank holiday after comparing train times.
examples.zh: 比过火车时刻后，我们把沿海旅行定在「英国春季公众假日」。

collocations: closed for the spring bank holiday

words.enDefinition: a UK bank holiday normally observed in early May

examples.en: The UK calendar showed the Early May bank holiday before the weekend we had chosen.
examples.zh: 英国日历显示，「英国五月初公众假日」在我们选的那个周末之前。

examples.en: We made lunch plans for the Early May bank holiday because neither of us had class.
examples.zh: 我们俩那天都没课，于是约在「英国五月初公众假日」吃午饭。

collocations: over the Early May bank holiday
Early May bank holiday opening hours
closed for the Early May bank holiday

words.enDefinition: a bank holiday in August whose usual date differs within the UK

examples.en: My student job had shorter opening hours on the summer bank holiday that year.
examples.zh: 那年「英国夏季公众假日」，我打学生工的地方缩短了营业时间。

examples.en: We compared the dates of the summer bank holiday in Scotland and in Wales.
examples.zh: 我们比较了苏格兰和威尔士的「英国夏季公众假日」日期。

collocations: closed for the summer bank holiday

words.enDefinition: a circular arrangement of flowers worn on the head

examples.en: A friend made a flower crown at the craft stall for her sister.
examples.zh: 朋友在手工摊位上为姐姐做了一个「花环头饰」。

examples.en: She wore a flower crown in the photograph from the spring celebration beside campus.
examples.zh: 校园旁的春季庆典照片里，她戴着一个「花环头饰」。

words.enDefinition: a day honouring mothers and other maternal figures

examples.en: I called my mother on Mother's Day after finishing my afternoon tutorial that year.
examples.zh: 那年「母亲节」，我上完下午的辅导课就给妈妈打了电话。

examples.en: The shop put a table of cards beside the door for Mother's Day.
examples.zh: 商店为了「母亲节」，在门旁摆了一桌卡片。

words.enDefinition: the fourth Sunday of Lent, often observed as Mother's Day in the UK

examples.en: The UK shop had signs for Mothering Sunday beside its spring flower display.
examples.zh: 英国那家店在春季鲜花展台旁放了「英国传统母亲节」的标牌。

examples.en: I asked my host family when they usually exchanged cards for Mothering Sunday.
examples.zh: 我问寄宿家庭，大家通常什么时候为「英国传统母亲节」互送卡片。

words.enDefinition: a day honouring fathers and other paternal figures

examples.en: My brother and I planned a video call for Father's Day while I studied abroad.
examples.zh: 我在国外读书时，和哥哥约好「父亲节」打视频电话。

examples.en: The community café advertised a family lunch for Father's Day near the park.
examples.zh: 公园附近的社区咖啡馆宣传「父亲节」有家庭午餐活动。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian holiday in May associated with the monarch's official birthday

examples.en: I used the Victoria Day weekend to visit a friend at another Canadian university.
examples.zh: 我利用「加拿大维多利亚日」长周末去看了在加拿大另一所大学读书的朋友。

examples.en: Our supervisor posted the museum's Victoria Day hours before we finished work on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五下班前，主管张贴了博物馆「加拿大维多利亚日」当天的开放时间。

words.enDefinition: Canada's national holiday, celebrated on July first

examples.en: We watched musicians perform outdoors on Canada Day with friends from our exchange programme.
examples.zh: 「加拿大国庆日」那天，我们和交换项目认识的朋友一起看了户外音乐表演。

examples.en: The community centre listed several activities for Canada Day on a board near reception.
examples.zh: 社区中心在前台旁的板上列出了几项「加拿大国庆日」的活动。

words.enDefinition: a June observance celebrating First Nations, Inuit, and Métis cultures and contributions in Canada

examples.en: The library hosted a public reading on National Indigenous Peoples Day in the main hall.
examples.zh: 「加拿大原住民日」当天，图书馆在大厅办了公开朗读活动。

examples.en: Our class visited a community exhibition for National Indigenous Peoples Day that June.
examples.zh: 那年六月，我们班参观了为「加拿大原住民日」举办的社区展览。

words.enDefinition: a day celebrating the diversity and contributions of Canada's cultural communities

examples.en: I joined a panel discussion about languages on Canadian Multiculturalism Day at the college.
examples.zh: 「加拿大多元文化日」那天，我在学院参加了一场讨论语言的专题活动。

examples.en: The town held a series of community performances for Canadian Multiculturalism Day that summer.
examples.zh: 那年夏天，镇上为「加拿大多元文化日」办了几场社区演出。

words.enDefinition: a June celebration of Francophone culture that is Quebec's national holiday

examples.en: Our French teacher explained why the town held special events for Saint-Jean-Baptiste Day.
examples.zh: 法语老师解释了镇上为什么会为「圣让巴蒂斯特节」安排特别活动。

examples.en: I joined friends at an outdoor concert on Saint-Jean-Baptiste Day during my Quebec exchange.
examples.zh: 在魁北克交换期间，我在「圣让巴蒂斯特节」那天和朋友去看了户外音乐会。

words.enDefinition: an August observance celebrating Acadian culture and heritage in Canada

examples.en: The library display for National Acadian Day included recordings of songs from the region.
examples.zh: 为「加拿大阿卡迪亚人日」布置的图书馆展览收录了当地歌曲的录音。

examples.en: We heard French spoken throughout the community festival for National Acadian Day that summer.
examples.zh: 那年夏天，在庆祝「加拿大阿卡迪亚人日」的社区节庆上，我们到处都能听到法语。

words.enDefinition: the Canadian flag featuring a central red maple leaf

examples.en: Someone hung a maple leaf flag outside the residence office for the July holiday.
examples.zh: 为了庆祝七月的节日，有人在宿管办公室外挂了一面「加拿大枫叶旗」。

examples.en: A large maple leaf flag hung behind the band on the outdoor stage.
examples.zh: 户外舞台上的乐队背后挂着一面大大的「加拿大枫叶旗」。

words.enDefinition: a US holiday honouring people who died in military service

examples.en: The library posted a notice about Memorial Day opening hours before classes ended.
examples.zh: 课程结束前，图书馆张贴了「美国阵亡将士纪念日」的开放时间告示。

examples.en: The town held a quiet ceremony on Memorial Day in the square near campus.
examples.zh: 「美国阵亡将士纪念日」当天，镇上在校园附近广场举办了一场安静的纪念仪式。

words.enDefinition: a gathering held to remember a person or people who have died

examples.en: The university choir sang at the memorial service in the old hall on Monday.
examples.zh: 大学合唱团周一在旧礼堂举行的「追思纪念仪式」上献唱。

examples.en: A friend asked whether the memorial service in the town square was open to visitors.
examples.zh: 朋友问，在镇广场举行的「追思纪念仪式」是否向访客开放。

words.enDefinition: to place a wreath somewhere as a gesture of remembrance or respect

examples.en: Two students were invited to lay a wreath during the community's May ceremony.
examples.zh: 两名学生受到邀请，在社区五月的纪念仪式上「敬献花圈」。

examples.en: We watched local volunteers lay a wreath at the memorial before the choir sang.
examples.zh: 合唱团演唱前，我们看着当地志愿者在纪念碑前「敬献花圈」。

collocations: lay a wreath at a memorial
invite someone to lay a wreath
lay a wreath in memory of someone

words.zhGloss: 美国六月十九日解放纪念日
words.enDefinition: a US holiday commemorating the announcement of emancipation in Galveston, Texas, on June nineteenth, 1865
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国六月十九日解放纪念日

examples.en: The campus museum organised a public history event for Juneteenth in its courtyard.
examples.zh: 校园博物馆在庭院里为「美国六月十九日解放纪念日」办了一场公众历史活动。

examples.en: I went to a talk about Juneteenth with people from my summer class.
examples.zh: 我和夏季课程的同学去听了一场关于「美国六月十九日解放纪念日」的讲座。

words.enDefinition: the US holiday on July fourth marking the country's declaration of independence

examples.en: My host family invited me to a picnic on Independence Day near the river.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭邀请我在「美国独立日」当天到河边野餐。

examples.en: The city announced extra train service for its Independence Day events that evening.
examples.zh: 市里宣布为当晚的「美国独立日」活动增开列车。

words.enDefinition: the planned order of groups or performers taking part in a parade

examples.en: I checked the parade lineup to see when our university group would appear.
examples.zh: 我查了「游行队伍出场顺序」，看我们学校的队伍什么时候出现。

examples.en: The parade lineup listed the musicians just before the group from our residence.
examples.zh: 「游行队伍出场顺序」把乐手排在我们宿舍的队伍之前。

words.enDefinition: an organized show of fireworks for people to watch

examples.en: We watched the fireworks display from the grass behind the community centre that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚我们在社区中心后面的草地上观看了「烟花表演」。

examples.en: The town moved the fireworks display to Saturday because rain was expected on Friday.
examples.zh: 预计周五有雨，镇上把「烟花表演」改到了周六。

words.enDefinition: the final part of a fireworks show, usually its most impressive section

examples.en: We stayed by the river long enough to see the fireworks finale together.
examples.zh: 我们一起在河边等到看完「烟花表演的压轴」。

examples.en: The programme listed a fireworks finale after the last song by the local band.
examples.zh: 节目单写着，本地乐队演完最后一首歌后是「烟花表演的压轴」。

words.enDefinition: a holiday honouring workers on the first Monday in September in the US and Canada

examples.en: The US community pool changed its opening hours after Labor Day at summer's end.
examples.zh: 夏末的「美加劳动节」过后，美国这家社区泳池更改了开放时间。

examples.en: I took the train home for Labour Day before my first classes in Canada.
examples.zh: 我在「美加劳动节」坐火车回家，之后再回加拿大的学校上开学后的第一批课。

words.enDefinition: a blanket spread on the ground to sit on during a picnic

examples.en: We borrowed a picnic blanket from our neighbour before meeting friends in the park.
examples.zh: 去公园和朋友碰头前，我们向邻居借了一条「野餐毯」。

examples.en: My friend folded the picnic blanket while I gathered the empty cups from the grass.
examples.zh: 我从草地上捡起空杯子时，朋友把「野餐毯」叠了起来。

words.enDefinition: a basket or container fitted for carrying picnic food and utensils

examples.en: We packed the picnic hamper with cups and bread before catching the bus.
examples.zh: 坐公交前，我们把杯子和面包装进「野餐提篮」。

examples.en: My neighbour lent me a picnic hamper for the afternoon at the park.
examples.zh: 邻居借给我一个「野餐提篮」，让我下午去公园用。

words.enDefinition: to bring your own food and supplies to eat outdoors

examples.en: The concert notice said we could bring a picnic to the park that evening.
examples.zh: 音乐会通知说，那晚我们可以「自带野餐食物」去公园。

examples.en: I asked the others whether to bring a picnic or buy food there.
examples.zh: 我问大家是「自带野餐食物」，还是到那里再买。

collocations: bring a picnic to the event
visitors are welcome to bring a picnic

words.enDefinition: a social gathering in someone's backyard with food cooked on a grill

examples.en: Our neighbour invited us to a backyard barbecue when the semester finished in June.
examples.zh: 六月学期结束时，邻居邀请我们去参加「后院烧烤聚会」。

examples.en: I brought a salad to the backyard barbecue at my classmate's house on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六我带了一份沙拉去同学家的「后院烧烤聚会」。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor gathering with food cooked outside, especially in North American usage

examples.en: The residence held a cookout at the park after exams were over that Friday.
examples.zh: 那周五考试结束后，宿舍在公园办了一场「户外烧烤聚餐」。

examples.en: I signed up to bring drinks to the cookout with my host family.
examples.zh: 我报名了寄宿家庭的「户外烧烤聚餐」，负责带饮料。

words.enDefinition: a social gathering for neighbours on the same city block, especially in North America

examples.en: The neighbours organised a block party with tables outside both apartment buildings that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，邻居们办了场「街坊聚会」，在两栋公寓楼外都摆了桌子。

examples.en: I met three students from nearby flats at the block party near our residence.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍附近的「街坊聚会」上认识了三个住在旁边公寓的学生。

words.enDefinition: a celebration held in a street, often closed to traffic for the occasion

examples.en: The road was closed for a street party hosted by several local community groups.
examples.zh: 为几家社区团体合办的「封街联欢活动」，这条路临时封闭了。

examples.en: Our friends joined the street party after helping set up tables near the library.
examples.zh: 帮忙在图书馆附近摆好桌子后，朋友们参加了「封街联欢活动」。

words.enDefinition: a public event with stalls or performances set up along a street

examples.en: I stopped at the street fair on my way back from the bus station.
examples.zh: 从公交总站回来的路上，我在「街头集市」停了一下。

examples.en: The street fair had a stall selling handmade notebooks from a nearby student cooperative.
examples.zh: 「街头集市」有个摊位，卖附近学生合作社做的手工笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a US community event typically featuring local exhibits, competitions, and attractions

examples.en: We went to the county fair after a friend recommended its local produce exhibits.
examples.zh: 朋友推荐了当地农产品展，我们就去逛了「美国县集市」。

examples.en: My host brother volunteered at a county fair near his town during summer break.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭的哥哥暑假在镇子附近的一场「美国县集市」做志愿者。

collocations: take part in a county fair

words.enDefinition: an area where a fair with stalls, games, or rides takes place

examples.en: The bus stopped near the fairground where we planned to meet our classmates.
examples.zh: 公交停在「游艺集市场地」附近，我们计划在那里和同学碰头。

examples.en: I could hear music from the fairground while walking to my summer job.
examples.zh: 我走去暑期打工的地方时，能听到「游艺集市场地」传来的音乐。

words.enDefinition: a moving amusement attraction people ride at a fair

examples.en: We watched our friends try a fairground ride before looking for the picnic area.
examples.zh: 我们先看朋友玩了一个「游乐设施」，才去找野餐区。

examples.en: The programme showed a height limit for each fairground ride beside its picture.
examples.zh: 节目册在每张图片旁标出了对应「游乐设施」的身高限制。

collocations: height limit for a fairground ride

words.enDefinition: strings of small flags used as decoration for a celebration

examples.en: The organisers hung festive bunting between the stalls before the market opened on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日集市开门前，组织者在摊位之间挂上了「节庆挂旗」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped take down the festive bunting after the street party had ended.
examples.zh: 街头联欢结束后，室友帮忙拆下了「节庆挂旗」。

words.enDefinition: an event where makers exhibit or sell handmade objects

examples.en: We bought two small bowls at the craft fair outside the university gallery.
examples.zh: 我们在大学美术馆外的「手工艺品集市」买了两只小碗。

examples.en: I helped a friend set out her handmade cards for the craft fair.
examples.zh: 我帮朋友把手工卡片摆好，准备在「手工艺品集市」出售。

words.enDefinition: an event with informal activities intended for families of different ages

examples.en: I volunteered at the family fun day in the park next to the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆旁公园举行的「家庭趣味活动日」做了志愿者。

examples.en: The family fun day offered short games and music at the community centre on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六的「家庭趣味活动日」在社区中心安排了小游戏和音乐。

words.enDefinition: a spring new year celebrated in Iran and other parts of Asia and beyond

examples.en: A classmate invited me to a Nowruz celebration at the community centre that spring.
examples.zh: 同学邀请我参加那年春天在社区中心举行的「诺鲁孜节」庆典。

examples.en: The museum's Nowruz display showed how some families welcome the return of spring.
examples.zh: 博物馆的「诺鲁孜节」展览展示了有些家庭怎样迎接春天归来。

words.enDefinition: a Nowruz display with at least seven symbolic items whose Persian names begin with the letter sin

examples.en: Our class saw a Haft Sin table at a campus Nowruz celebration that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，我们班在校园的诺鲁孜节庆典上看到了「诺鲁孜节七件陈设桌」。

examples.en: My friend explained one object on her family's Haft Sin table before we ate.
examples.zh: 吃饭前，朋友介绍了她家「诺鲁孜节七件陈设桌」上的一件物品。

collocations: set up a Haft Sin table
items on a Haft Sin table

words.enDefinition: a Hindu spring festival widely associated with celebrations using coloured powders

examples.en: Several students volunteered at the campus Holi celebration in the park near residence.
examples.zh: 几名学生在宿舍附近公园举办的校园「胡里节」活动中做了志愿者。

examples.en: I learned about Holi from a classmate whose family celebrated it every spring.
examples.zh: 我从一位同学那里了解了「胡里节」，他们家每年春天都会过。

words.enDefinition: powder containing colour, used in some festivities such as Holi

examples.en: The photos showed clouds of coloured powder above the crowd at the Holi event.
examples.zh: 照片上，胡里节现场人群上方扬起一团团「节庆彩色粉末」。

examples.en: My friend still had coloured powder on her sleeve when we took the bus home.
examples.zh: 我们坐公交回家时，朋友的袖子上还留着「节庆彩色粉末」。

words.enDefinition: a friendly greeting for people celebrating Holi

examples.en: My friend wrote “Happy Holi” in the group chat before the campus celebration started.
examples.zh: 校园庆典开始之前，朋友在群里写道“「胡里节快乐」”。

examples.en: I heard someone say “Happy Holi” as we approached the music stage together.
examples.zh: 我们一起走近音乐舞台时，我听见有人说“「胡里节快乐」”。

words.enDefinition: a flower from a cherry tree, often enjoyed in spring

examples.en: A cherry blossom landed on my notebook while I was studying outdoors after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后在户外学习，一朵「樱花」落在了笔记本上。

examples.en: My host family showed me a photo of a cherry blossom from their garden.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭给我看了他们花园里一朵「樱花」的照片。

words.enDefinition: the period when cherry trees in an area are generally flowering

examples.en: I planned my visit for cherry blossom season so we could walk by the river.
examples.zh: 我把探访安排在「樱花花期」，这样我们可以到河边走走。

examples.en: The university's garden stayed open later during cherry blossom season for visitors.
examples.zh: 「樱花花期」期间，学校花园为访客延长了开放时间。

words.enDefinition: a public event celebrating the flowering of cherry trees

examples.en: The cherry blossom festival offered guided walks through the garden beside campus on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日的「樱花节」在校园旁的花园安排了导览散步。

examples.en: I went to a cherry blossom festival with my classmates during our spring visit.
examples.zh: 春季参访时，我和同学去参加了一场「樱花节」。

words.enDefinition: the Japanese custom of gathering to view blossoms, especially cherry blossoms

examples.en: Some exchange students invited me to hanami under cherry trees beside their campus.
examples.zh: 几位交换生邀请我到他们校园旁的樱花树下体验「日本赏樱习俗」。

examples.en: The Japan society explained hanami before its spring picnic in the botanical garden.
examples.zh: 日本文化社在植物园办春季野餐前，先介绍了「日本赏樱习俗」。

words.enDefinition: the stage when flowering reaches its fullest

examples.en: The park estimated peak bloom for the middle of the following week that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，公园预计下一周中段会进入「盛花期」。

examples.en: Our tutor booked the walk during peak bloom so the class could see the trees.
examples.zh: 导师把散步安排在「盛花期」，这样全班都能看到开花的树。

words.enDefinition: an event celebrating tulips in bloom, often with public gardens and activities

examples.en: We walked to the tulip festival after our friend finished her weekend shift.
examples.zh: 朋友周末下班后，我们步行去了「郁金香节」。

examples.en: The tulip festival map showed which flower beds were open to visit that morning.
examples.zh: 「郁金香节」地图标出了那天上午哪些花坛开放参观。

words.enDefinition: a person attending a public festival

examples.en: A festival-goer asked whether we knew where the second entrance to the park was.
examples.zh: 一名「节庆活动参加者」问我们知不知道公园的第二个入口在哪儿。

examples.en: I met another festival-goer from my university while waiting for the evening bus.
examples.zh: 等晚间公交时，我遇到另一位同校的「节庆活动参加者」。

words.enDefinition: a platform outside where performers appear before an audience

examples.en: The dance group practised on the outdoor stage before the gates opened.
examples.zh: 大门开放前，舞蹈团在「露天舞台」上排练。

examples.en: We sat on the grass near the outdoor stage for the student performances.
examples.zh: 我们坐在「露天舞台」旁的草地上看学生演出。

words.enDefinition: the area set aside for a festival and its activities

examples.en: We reached the festival grounds by walking through the park behind our residence.
examples.zh: 我们穿过宿舍后面的公园，到达了「节庆会场区域」。

examples.en: The map of the festival grounds showed a quiet area near the far entrance.
examples.zh: 「节庆会场区域」的地图标出了靠远端入口的一处安静区域。

words.enDefinition: a schedule listing a festival's events, times, and locations

examples.en: I checked the festival programme to see which performance followed the outdoor dance show.
examples.zh: 我查看了「节庆活动节目单」，想知道户外舞蹈后面是哪场演出。

examples.en: The festival programme included a short introduction to each of the student groups performing.
examples.zh: 「节庆活动节目单」简要介绍了每个登台的学生团体。

words.enDefinition: a wristband used to show a person has entry to a festival

examples.en: The volunteer checked my festival wristband when I returned from the bus station.
examples.zh: 我从车站回来时，志愿者检查了我的「节庆入场腕带」。

examples.en: I kept my festival wristband in a notebook after the summer market ended.
examples.zh: 夏季集市结束后，我把「节庆入场腕带」放进了笔记本留作纪念。

words.enDefinition: a designated area with facilities or activities intended for families at an event

examples.en: The festival volunteers showed me the family zone near the shaded picnic tables.
examples.zh: 节庆志愿者给我指了荫凉野餐桌旁的「亲子活动区」。

examples.en: My neighbour waited in the family zone while her children finished making paper flowers.
examples.zh: 邻居在「亲子活动区」等孩子们做完纸花。

words.enDefinition: an event notice asking attendees to provide their own seat

examples.en: The summer concert poster said bring your own chair near the entrance information.
examples.zh: 夏季音乐会海报在入场信息旁写着「请自备座椅」。

examples.en: I saw bring your own chair on the notice before deciding what to carry.
examples.zh: 决定带什么之前，我在告示上看到了「请自备座椅」。

words.enDefinition: seating in which people sit on blankets instead of chairs

examples.en: The show offered blanket seating on the lawn in front of the main stage.
examples.zh: 演出允许观众在主舞台前的草坪上「铺毯席地而坐」。

examples.en: I picked the blanket seating area because our group wanted to sit together.
examples.zh: 我们这组想坐在一起，所以我选了「铺毯席地坐席」的区域。

words.enDefinition: a local event held to raise money for a shared project or cause

examples.en: We helped sell plants at a community fundraiser beside the student library in June.
examples.zh: 六月，我们在学生图书馆旁边的「社区筹款活动」上帮忙卖植物。

examples.en: The community fundraiser paid for new picnic tables at the garden near campus.
examples.zh: 「社区筹款活动」为校园附近的花园筹到了购买新野餐桌的钱。

collocations: community fundraiser for a local project

words.enDefinition: an outdoor or seasonal market operating during the summer

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit at the summer market after walking through the campus garden.
examples.zh: 穿过校园花园后，我们在「夏季集市」买了新鲜水果。

examples.en: My flatmate sold handmade bookmarks at the summer market on several weekends that year.
examples.zh: 那年有几个周末，室友在「夏季集市」卖手工书签。

words.enDefinition: the part of a North American fair with amusement rides, stands, or games

examples.en: My host sister showed me the midway after we finished looking at the displays.
examples.zh: 看完展品后，寄宿家的姐姐带我去看「北美集市游乐区」。

examples.en: We agreed to meet at the far end of the midway before catching the bus.
examples.zh: 我们约定坐公交之前在「北美集市游乐区」的另一端碰头。

words.enDefinition: short games at a fair where people try to win prizes or have fun

examples.en: We tried two fairground games before my friend's little brother wanted to go home.
examples.zh: 朋友的小弟弟想回家前，我们玩了两个「游艺集市小游戏」。

examples.en: The fairground games were set up behind the tents where food was sold.
examples.zh: 「游艺集市小游戏」设在卖食物的帐篷后面。

words.enDefinition: a stand set up for displaying, selling, or making handmade objects

examples.en: My classmates decorated their craft booth with pieces they had made during term.
examples.zh: 同学们用学期中做的作品装饰了他们的「手工艺品摊位」。

examples.en: I stopped at a craft booth to buy a card for my host family.
examples.zh: 我在一个「手工艺品摊位」停下，给寄宿家庭买了张卡片。

words.enDefinition: a temporary space at a fair where judges evaluate competition entries

examples.en: The pumpkin exhibits stood outside the judging tent before the fair opened that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午集市开放前，参展南瓜摆在「展品评比帐篷」外。

examples.en: My host family showed me the judging tent after taking me around the fair.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭带我逛了一圈集市，又带我看了「展品评比帐篷」。

words.enDefinition: a series of organised activities offered during a school or public holiday

examples.en: The community centre posted its holiday programme on the door near the bus stop.
examples.zh: 社区中心在公交站旁的门上贴出了「假期系列活动」信息。

examples.en: I signed up to help at the holiday programme before leaving campus for summer.
examples.zh: 暑假离校前，我报名协助「假期系列活动」。

words.enDefinition: an unpaid person who helps carry out work at a festival

examples.en: A festival volunteer handed me a map at the entrance to the garden.
examples.zh: 在花园入口，一位「节庆志愿者」给了我一张地图。

examples.en: My flatmate worked as a festival volunteer during the weekend after our exams.
examples.zh: 考试结束后的那个周末，室友去做了「节庆志愿者」。

collocations: sign up as a festival volunteer

words.enDefinition: an event bringing several mobile food trucks together at one location

examples.en: We went to a food truck rally after the outdoor concert behind the library.
examples.zh: 图书馆后面的户外音乐会结束后，我们去了一场「餐车集会」。

examples.en: The food truck rally had picnic tables where we could sit with other students.
examples.zh: 「餐车集会」摆了野餐桌，方便我们和其他学生坐在一起。

words.enDefinition: celebratory events held outside, often as part of a larger occasion

examples.en: The town moved the start of the outdoor festivities to later in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 镇上把「户外庆祝活动」的开始时间改到了下午晚一些。

examples.en: We watched the outdoor festivities from the bridge before meeting friends in the square.
examples.zh: 我们先在桥上看了「户外庆祝活动」，再去广场和朋友见面。

words.enDefinition: an event marking the close of the summer season

examples.en: The college held an end-of-summer celebration for students finishing their short courses that week.
examples.zh: 学院为那周结课的短期课程学生举办了「夏末庆祝活动」。

examples.en: My neighbours brought fruit to the end-of-summer celebration at the small community garden.
examples.zh: 邻居带了水果来参加小社区花园的「夏末庆祝活动」。

words.enDefinition: a live music event held outdoors

examples.en: We packed a blanket for the open-air concert because seating was on the lawn.
examples.zh: 「露天音乐会」的座位在草坪上，我们就带了条毯子。

examples.en: The local orchestra held an open-air concert for families during the July holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 七月假日周末，当地管弦乐团为家庭观众举办了一场「露天音乐会」。
